name: Farm Resort Geislerhof
beschreibung:
Perched at 1,250 metres on a sunny hillside above Gerlos in the Zillertal, Farm Resort Geislerhof unites alpine luxury with genuine farmstead authenticity. Standalone timber chalets feature private spas with saunas, hot tubs, and generous living areas.

Children delight in farm life with cows, ponies, and small animals, while the expansive Zillertal Arena provides limitless adventures in summer and winter.
kurzbeschreibung: Farm Resort Geislerhof in Gerlos offers exclusive luxury chalets and an authentic farmstay experience in the Zillertal valley.
